fields.name: graph_name
fields.description:
The graph name. For example: my-graph-1.
								The name must contain from 1 to 63 letters, numbers, or hyphens, 
								and its first character must be a letter. It cannot end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens.
								If you don't specify a graph name, a unique graph name is generated for you using the prefix graph-for, 
								followed by a combination of Stack Name and a UUID.

fields.name: graph_name_prefix
fields.description: Allows user to specify name prefix and have remainder of name automatically generated.

fields.name: kms_key_identifier
fields.description: Specifies a KMS key to use to encrypt data in the new graph.  Value must be ARN of KMS Key.

fields.name: provisioned_memory
fields.description: The provisioned memory-optimized Neptune Capacity Units (m-NCUs) to use for the graph.

fields.name: public_connectivity
fields.description:
Specifies whether or not the graph can be reachable over the internet. 
								All access to graphs is IAM authenticated.
								When the graph is publicly available, its domain name system (DNS) endpoint resolves to 
								the public IP address from the internet. When the graph isn't publicly available, you need 
								to create a PrivateGraphEndpoint in a given VPC to ensure the DNS name resolves to a private 
								IP address that is reachable from the VPC.

fields.name: allocated_storage
fields.description:
The amount of storage to allocate for your DB storage type in GiB (gibibytes).
					This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters (when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group).

fields.name: bucket
fields.description:
Name of the initial InfluxDB bucket. All InfluxDB data is stored in a bucket.
					A bucket combines the concept of a database and a retention period (the duration of time
					that each data point persists). A bucket belongs to an organization. Along with organization,
					username, and password, this argument will be stored in the secret referred to by the
					influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn attribute. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters
					(when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group).

fields.name: db_instance_type
fields.description: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance type to run InfluxDB on.

fields.name: db_parameter_group_identifier
fields.description:
The ID of the DB parameter group to assign to your DB cluster. 
					DB parameter groups specify how the database is configured. For example, DB parameter groups 
					can specify the limit for query concurrency.

fields.name: db_storage_type
fields.description:
The Timestream for InfluxDB DB storage type to read and write InfluxDB data. 
					You can choose between 3 different types of provisioned Influx IOPS included storage according 
					to your workloads requirements: Influx IO Included 3000 IOPS, Influx IO Included 12000 IOPS, 
					Influx IO Included 16000 IOPS.

fields.name: deployment_type
fields.description:
Specifies the type of cluster to create. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters
					(when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group).

fields.name: failover_mode
fields.description:
Specifies the behavior of failure recovery when the primary node of the cluster
					fails.

fields.name: name
fields.description:
The name that uniquely identifies the DB cluster when interacting with the 
					Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB API and CLI commands. This name will also be a 
					prefix included in the endpoint. DB cluster names must be unique per customer 
					and per region.

fields.name: network_type
fields.description:
Specifies whether the networkType of the Timestream for InfluxDB cluster is 
					IPV4, which can communicate over IPv4 protocol only, or DUAL, which can communicate 
					over both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols.

fields.name: organization
fields.description:
Name of the initial organization for the initial admin user in InfluxDB. An
					InfluxDB organization is a workspace for a group of users. Along with bucket, username,
					and password, this argument will be stored in the secret referred to by the
					influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn attribute. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters
					(when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group).

fields.name: password
fields.description:
Password of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB. This password will
					allow you to access the InfluxDB UI to perform various administrative tasks and
					also use the InfluxDB CLI to create an operator token. Along with bucket, username,
					and organization, this argument will be stored in the secret referred to by the
					influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn attribute. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters
					(when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group) as the AWS API rejects it.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port number on which InfluxDB accepts connections.

fields.name: publicly_accessible
fields.description: Configures the Timestream for InfluxDB cluster with a public IP to facilitate access.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.name: username
fields.description:

					and can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens. This username will allow
					you to access the InfluxDB UI to perform various administrative tasks and also use the
					InfluxDB CLI to create an operator token. Along with bucket, organization, and password,
					this argument will be stored in the secret referred to by the influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn
					attribute. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters (when using an InfluxDB V3 db parameter group).
